text:
Priya R.: Heads up — prepping an exec readout for AtlasHealth next Tue (2pm PT). Need owners for slides: onboarding status, renewal risks, enablement demo, and feedback capture. I've sketched a renewal heatmap and a quick ask list. Please ack and call dibs. Link: https://docs.google.com/atlas-health-qbr

Sam L.: Ack. I'll take onboarding + migration blockers slide. Will pull latest activation funnel.

Mia T.: On it — refreshing activation & retention numbers now. Will post new chart by 5pm.

Jordan K.: I can run the enablement demo if I get staging creds and a short script. @Priya R. can you confirm scope? 

Priya R.: Thanks — assigning: onboarding = @Sam L., metrics = @Mia T., demo = @Jordan K., action tracker = @Liam P. Can each owner drop one bullet of what they need (access, assets, slide deck) by EOD? :thumbsup:

Liam P.: I'll own the action tracker and follow-ups. Created a tracker draft: https://airtable.com/shrTracker. Will add columns: owner, due, status, follow-up. 

Sam L.: Need product logs and recent support tickets (last 30d). @eng-support can you export or point me to the report? Also noting possible config change two weeks ago that affected batched exports.

Mia T.: FYI — usage dipped ~22% MoM for the main workspace. Adding a small heatmap in the doc to flag renewal risk tiers.

Priya R.: Important — if we escalate the renewal risk to execs we need remediation ask + cost impact estimate. @Sam L. can you confirm if the rate-limit change correlates? @Jordan K. if demo depends on that flow we should mock.

Sam L.: Confirming — I see a spike in 429s around the deploy. I'll pull logs and share a snippet in this thread.

deply-bot: (note) intended deploy bot message alternative

deploy-bot: config-rate-limiter v2.3 deployed by @devops at 2024-11-08T14:12:03Z

Jordan K.: I'll prepare a demo fallback that doesn't rely on the export pipeline. Will add a note in the slide.

Priya R.: Nice. Quick slide owners summary (paste into deck):
```
- Onboarding slides: Sam L. (needs logs + tickets)
- Health metrics: Mia T. (needs DB access to analytics)
- Enablement demo: Jordan K. (needs staging creds)
- Action tracker + follow-ups: Liam P. (owns post-QBR outreach)
``` 

Mia T.: Adding engagement quotes from CSM interviews and a short NPS snippet.

Liam P.: I'll run a pre-read to execs Wed morning and collect any asks. I'll also create follow-up templates for renewal outreach.

Priya R.: Perfect. If no blockers, let's reconvene tomorrow 10am for a 30m slide sync. If anyone can't make it, drop asynchronous updates here. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Sam L.: :thumbsup:

Mia T.: :eyes:

Jordan K.: Will do.
